decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform is the firm's flagship product line and central to its strategic direction, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture is close to the core offering and in steady demand from public and utility customers, though it may be folded into the platform.
The search extension was actively versioned in 2019 and complements the map.apps ecosystem, but sibling plugins were dropped, so there is some risk of consolidation.
